traits.name: Sin Scent
traits.text: A sinspawn can smell creatures that reflect its sin, as the scent ability. The GM determines which creatures are appropriately sinful.

traits.name: Items
traits.text: one weapon determined by its sin;

traits.name: Sinful Bite
traits.text: (arcane, emotion, mental); A creature hit by the jaws of a sinspawn must attempt a DC 18 Will save as it is assailed by sinful thoughts. Success Sickened 1. Critical Success Unaffected. Failure Sickened 2. Critical Failure Sickened 2 plus an additional penalty, determined by the sinspawn's sin, while it remains sickened.

traits.name: Sin
traits.text: A sinspawn gains an additional skill based on its sin, as well as a weapon that reflects the preferences of its kinds' ancient creators. The seven sins and the benefits they confer upon a sinspawn are noted in the Sinspawn Sins section.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ jaws +10 (agile); Damage 1d8+4 (1d8+4) piercing plus sinful bite

meta.items: one weapon determined by its sin;
